messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up team 1: handbook v2.7 draft is live with Accessibility & Localized Training annexes. Goal: mandatory accessibility awareness for all product, design, and support staff + translated microcourses for EMEA/APAC. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/handbook/v2.7 :book:
Ben Ortiz: Nice. How are we tracking completion for localized cohorts? Last rollout we lost people in timezone gaps. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Aisha Khan: Two-pronged approach: LMS cohorts by region + manager confirmations. We're enabling auto-tagging by office region and preferred language at onboarding sync. lms-bot will surface untranslated enrollments.
Diane Park: Are contractors included for accessibility training? Our support contractors handle tickets with customer content.
Jill (Legal): If contractors have access to customer content or support tools, yes they should be assigned the Accessibility module. We added that to the "Assignment Rules" table in the annex.
Evan Brooks: Can we make the accessibility a short microcourse (10-15min) with a quick quiz? That increases completion rates.
Aisha Khan: Yes 1. Microcourse + 3-question quiz + a "return-to-desk" checklist for support. Passing score 80%. No extra attestation required beyond completion except for managers.
lms-bot: New cohort created: "handbook-v2.7-accessibility" 1 - 1,024 assigned (auto-tag: office_region, role). Auto-reminders: 48h, 7d, 14d.
Ben Ortiz: For managers, we need a consolidated CSV by team and language. Is there a peopleops report?
Diane Park: Use `po reports completion --cohort handbook-v2.7-accessibility --group-by manager --include language` per Sam's query from last quarter.
Aisha Khan: I'll publish a manager digest template. Also planning localized drop-in Q&A sessions: Spanish, German, Japanese. Volunteers to present?
Evan Brooks: I can do the Spanish session (support track). Happy to run a 30m drop-in.
Ben Ortiz: I'll cover German.
Jill (Legal): I reviewed the accessibility annex. One legal ask: for customer-facing roles we need a signed acknowledgment that agents will follow the Accessibility Guidelines appendix. Recommend checkbox + name + date for those teams only.
Aisha Khan: OK we'll conditionally require the signed acknowledgment for roles with tag {support, sales, cs}. lms-bot: Can you add conditional checkbox?
lms-bot: Received: add-conditional-acknowledgment(cohort=handbook-v2.7-accessibility, role_tags=[support,sales,cs]) 1. Job queued. ETA 4h.
Ben Ortiz: For non-English translations, where are the translated scripts stored? I want to review the German deck before presenting.
Aisha Khan: Repo: https://docs.redwood/translations/handbook/v2.7/accessibility. We're using vendor X for initial translation and internal reviewers for accuracy. Please add comments in the Google doc.
Diane Park: On escalation: what happens if an agent fails to complete in 14 days? We had repeat noncompliance last cycle.
Jill (Legal): Standard flow: manager escalation at 7d; people-ops outreach at 14d. For repeat offenders in customer-facing roles, restrict ticket assignment until complete (legal-approved). Documented in Policy Sanctions appendix.
Aisha Khan: I'll add a small workflow diagram to the annex. Also creating an exceptions form for new hires starting late or on parental leave.
Evan Brooks: Any improvements to the manager confirmation flow? Last time managers forgot to confirm in-thread.
Aisha Khan: Adding `peopleops-bot` manager digest DM with a one-click confirm button that posts back here. peopleops-bot will also attach a CSV export link.
peopleops-bot: Manager digest scheduled: 1723461000 1. Managers below 80% will be DMed with one-click confirm.
Ben Ortiz: Can the CSV be filtered by language so I can send the German list to my presenter?
Aisha Khan: Yup, CSV supports `language` and `team` filters. Example export: `po export --cohort handbook-v2.7-accessibility --filter language=de --format csv`
Diane Park: We should also surface a short FAQ for agents who think it's optional. Last time we had a bunch of questions about whether it counts as mandatory training.
Aisha Khan: Good call. I'll add FAQ entries: "Who is required?", "How long?", "Consequences" and "Translation availability".
Jill (Legal): Quick wording suggestion for FAQ: "This training is mandatory for employees with customer-facing or product/design responsibilities. Completion is required within 21 days of assignment."
Aisha Khan: I'll use that wording. Plan: publish handbook v2.7 final tomorrow, enable cohorts & conditional ack that afternoon, and run first manager digest 24h after launch.
lms-bot: Snapshot export scheduled for compliance audit: 1723540000 1. Includes cohort completion timestamps and conditional acknowledgment fields.
Evan Brooks: Thanks all. I'll prep Spanish slide deck and mock quiz.
Ben Ortiz: I'll review German translation tonight and ping Aisha with edits.
Diane Park: I'll draft the exceptions form.
